The unchanged desktop-app source fails `music-player walk_order::tests::a_file_that_is_not_listed_lands_where_the_walk_would_put_it` on macOS Intel.
The assertion is at `package/music-player/desktop-app/src/walk_order_tests.rs:75:13`.
The complete nextest recovery uses the original package task and environment with only `--no-fail-fast` added in memory.
This records the failing test boundary. It does not establish a shared cause with other keyboard, focus, watcher, or fixture failures.

- Source `cb95cf6d785c3073c192b95f0632cdae7b910894`: [run 38847322477, job 116800698226](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/actions/runs/38847322477/job/116800698226), log line 4476.
